metadata.description: Curated collection of Claude Code skills — research, writing, and more.

plugins.name: web-tool-routing
plugins.description: Web tool routing, detection, and fallback chains for any skill that accesses websites. Provides credit-aware tool selection.

plugins.name: prompt-creator
plugins.description: Prompt engineering best practices from Anthropic and OpenAI docs. Crafts effective prompts for any LLM.

plugins.name: prompt-74
plugins.description: High-stakes prompt engineering methodology for real-world decisions and deep research. Generates structured, evidence-driven prompts using the PROMPT-74 framework.

plugins.name: web-research
plugins.description: Web research methodology with wave-based execution, query strategies, and structured output.

plugins.name: competitor-research
plugins.description: Research competitors by gathering and analyzing community feedback from Reddit, forums, and review sites.

plugins.name: researching-consumer-goods
plugins.description: Researches consumer products for purchase across global markets. Compares prices, checks availability, finds deals.

plugins.name: writing-well
plugins.description: Applies Zinsser's nonfiction writing principles — simplicity, clarity, active voice, clutter elimination — to any text.

plugins.name: plan-review
plugins.description: Reviews implementation plans and code changes with structured technical analysis across architecture, code quality, testing, performance, and risk.

plugins.name: harness-protocol
plugins.description: Orchestrator → Developer → Verifier → Auditor harness for multi-sprint / multi-file work. Generator never self-evaluates. >9/10 per-criterion threshold. Auditor scores against typed Vn assertions from a Validation Contract authored before any code. Hard dependency on obra/superpowers. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: go
plugins.description: End-to-end feature pipeline: plan → Validation Contract → harness protocol → plan-review → Codex audit → execute → simplify → final Codex audit. Runs inside an isolated git worktree. Hard dependency on obra/superpowers (Phase 1 fail-fast probe). Codex is optional; skipped when CLI unavailable. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: quick
plugins.description: Single-task feature pipeline for 1-3 file changes. Plan → tasks-for-sonnet placement + in-place plan shaping → optional Codex review → subagent-driven-development → done. No worktree, no harness, no Validation Contract. Routes to /go when boundary triggers (money / auth / migration / >5 files / client-trust / schema / state-drift / provider-reliability / PII / lifecycle / live-runtime-path) fire. Hard dependency on obra/superpowers. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: devil-advocate
plugins.description: Adversarial independent reviewer — spawns a fresh-context sub-agent to attack a plan, PR, design, or RFC. Severity rubric, concrete-edit requirement, anti-fabrication rule. Distinct from plan-review (which surveys).

plugins.name: retrospective
plugins.description: Structured project retrospective — mines sessions, audits git + plans, cross-checks epistemic layers, spawns devil-advocate, emits a dated retro plan. Project-agnostic — walks up from $PWD to find the project root.

plugins.name: tasks-for-sonnet
plugins.description: Invariant-first task-writing for junior implementation agents (Sonnet / Haiku / any LLM acting as Developer). Converts vague instructions into mechanically verifiable tasks; ships a trigger catalog promoted from observed external-reviewer catches (client-trust boundary, schema bounds, state drift, provider reliability, PII). Project-agnostic; pairs with harness-protocol and plan-execution.
